history.p: "I Provence" was written especially for Musikforeningen. After the first performance Hartmann wrote to his son Carl in Rome: "'I Provence' blev givet i Musikforeningen til sidste Concert, og gjorde overmaade megen Lykke hos Alle. Jeg troer jeg bliver populair paa mine gamle Dage." ("O Province" was given with great success at the last concert of Musikforeningen. I think I'am becoming popular in my old days).

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in cloth with marbled sides. Handwritten label in Hartmann's hand pasted on the cover: "'I Provence', / Digt af Carl Andersen, / componeret for Chor / og Orchester / af / I:P:E:Hartmann / Jan: 1869. / Op: 68 [added in pencil:]." In upper right-hand corner of the title page: "A IV 5.2. P. 4." Written in brown ink with additions in blue crayon. Paper: 22 staves. Paginated in blue crayon 1-49. Page 50 blank. On p. 19 three bars cancelled. On the inner side of the sleeve in pencil in foreign hand: "Opført i 28/3 i Musikforeningen"; and in blue crayon: "Opført d 29/3 i Musikforeningen".
